test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A company employed 700 men and 300 women and the average wage was Rs. 450 per day. If a man got Rs. 50 more than a woman, then the daily wage of the women is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

Total Wage = 1000 × 450 = Rs. 4,50,000

Extra amount given to 700 men = 700 × 50 = Rs. 35,000

Total wage if all were women = 4,50,000 − 35,000 = Rs. 4,15,000

Daily wage of a woman = 4,15,000 ÷ 1000 = Rs. 415

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of men (n₁) = 700

Number of women (n₂) = 300

Average wage of all employees = Rs. 450

Man wage − Woman wage = Rs. 50

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁ × x₁ + n₂ × x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 
 
 700 Men
 300 Women
 Wage: (x + 50)
 Wage: x
 
• 
 Combined Avg = Rs. 450

Let the daily wage of a woman be Rs. x.

Daily wage of a man = Rs. (x + 50)

⇒ Total employees = 700 + 300 = 1000

⇒ Total daily wage = 1000 × 450 = 4,50,000

⇒ 700 × (x + 50) + 300 × x = 4,50,000

⇒ 700x + 35,000 + 300x = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x + 35,000 = 4,50,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,50,000 − 35,000

⇒ 1000x = 4,15,000

⇒ x = 4,15,000 ÷ 1000

⇒ x = 415

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average Formula

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average via Deviation

If the average is A, the sum of deviations of all observations from A is always zero.

Alligation Method

The ratio of the quantities is inversely proportional to the differences between their individual values and the mean value: n₁/n₂ = (Mean − A₂) / (A₁ − Mean).</p
